Hi Priya,

Thanks for walking us through the demo last week. Procurement and finance dug into the usage snapshot you sent and we have two immediate asks: one, can we get a straightforward path to move 10% of our seat allocation from the standard tier to the high-throughput tier for our triage workflows; two, is there a way to bundle realtime inference credits with the higher tier without committing to a full annual step-up? Michael (cc'd) is leading the procurement review.

We're trying to avoid a large upfront bump in committed spend—would prefer a more transitional approach for Q3. Also attaching a quick internal usage extract so you can see peak windows.

Thanks,
Asha
HelioHealth — Head of ML Platforms

Attachments: usage_snapshot-q1.csv (csv)

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Michael Cho <michael.cho@heliohealth.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement rebalance & upgrade options for HelioHealth

Hi Asha / Michael —

Really appreciate the context and the snapshot — helpful. Short answers up front: yes, we can move a percentage of seats between tiers (we call that an entitlement rebalance) and yes, we offer a modular credit add-on that can be attached to a higher tier for burstable realtime tokens without requiring a full annual uplift.

Options I recommend we evaluate (quick summary):

1) Scoped Rebalance + Temp Credits (recommended pilot)
- Move 10% of existing standard seats to HT (high-throughput) for a 90-day pilot.
- Attach a pool of realtime inference credits (prepaid monthly) sized to observed peaks (I used your snapshot to estimate ~120k realtime-token credits/month).
- Pricing: pro-rated tier swap for pilot window + credits at a 20% list discount.

2) Canary Upgrade with Step Discount
- Canary 10% to HT for 30 days; if latency/throughput goals met, automatic step to 25% at slightly higher commitment.
- Credits included at a lower discount but with rollover for 3 months.

3) Straight Annual Upgrade w/ Anchor Discount
- Full annual upgrade to HT with a 12-month commit; best unit pricing but largest upfront spend.

I'll draft the exact math and an SOW for option 1 if you want to move forward. For procurement, Michael, typical asks we expect: clear billing primitives (which seats moved, credit burn tracking), cancellation/change windows, and prorated charges. We can include those terms in the SOW.

Quick Q for you both: do you prefer credits billed as a distinct line item (recommended for accounting) or bundled into the HT unit price?

I'll loop in Ben for pricing flexibility and Lauren for approval on concession thresholds.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Attachments: HelioHealth_SOW_v2.pdf (pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 13:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Entitlement rebalance & upgrade options for HelioHealth

Priya — forwarding quick notes on the pricing side.

On pricing flexibility: we can do option 1 with a capped credit discount and a one-time migration credit to offset pro-ration (~5% of pilot month cost). We should avoid giving more than 20% on credits for pilots. If they ask for credits to be bundled into HT unit price, that changes the math and we should escalate to Lauren (larger revenue impact, harder to unwind).

Suggested numbers (ballpark):
- Pro-rated seat swap (10% of 120 seats assumed) = charge for 12 HT seats for pilot window. HT unit = $2.10 / 1k tokens (example).
- Realtime credits pool = 120k tokens/month * $0.012/token list = $1,440 list -> offer $1,152 (20% pilot discount).
- Migration credit = $300 one-time.

If they want a canary-to-25% auto-step, we can add a 3-month lookback clause and a 10% loyalty credit on months 2-3.

Happy to share a clean pricing table for the SOW.

Ben
Senior Sales — Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Entitlement rebalance & upgrade options for HelioHealth

Ben / Priya — look reasonable. Approve the pilot concession structure with these constraints:
- Pilot discounts capped at 20% on credits and one-time migration credit not to exceed $500 equivalent.
- No bundling of credits into HT unit price unless Helio commits to 9+ months total (we don't want to bake recurring discounts into unit rates).
- Add a clause for "rollback" — if post-pilot telemetry shows >5% SLA regressions, they can roll back without penalty within 10 days.

Priya, once you get Asha's preference on billing line-items I approve proceeding with the SOW and a single DocuSign for the 90-day pilot SOW + credit addendum.

Thanks,
Lauren
Revenue Operations Lead — Redwood Inference
